findings.slide: Stages 1 to 3: the cut and the clot
findings.problem: The if_then adds a hint that is not in the SoW: 'Think about what is small and has no nucleus. Turn to your partner for 20 seconds.' This gives away the answer for platelets and adds a pair-talk step the SoW does not have. The answer key also adds 'fibrin' and 'disc-shaped'. Platelets are fragments that help form fibrin from fibrinogen made elsewhere, so 'fibrin' is loose science. The build_log logs 'fibrin' but not the hint or 'disc-shaped'.
findings.fix: Remove the pair-talk hint, or replace it with the SoW's open-to-the-class prompt ('Can anyone add the organelle or structure detail?'). Say 'clotting proteins, for example fibrin' in the key and log 'disc-shaped' as an added_fact.

findings.problem: The deck gives the summative assessment only 15 minutes. It covers four task types: labelling, a Kenyan-context explanation, a plant vs. animal comparison and wound-healing questions. Meanwhile the deck spends about 2 minutes each on several set-up slides. The SoW says only 'as per school policy', so the 15 minutes is the deck's own choice. It is logged, but it is tight for a large class.
findings.fix: Keep the SoW wording that the school sets the time. If possible, move 2–3 minutes from the set-up slides (class story set-up, the Lesson 1 side-by-side slide, the DQB colours slide) to the assessment, or tell the teacher clearly that the assessment may run past 15 minutes.

findings.problem: The notes on who to call first conflict. This slide says to put the learners with the strongest shift first. The hardest-question slide says to give Student H, the last call, to one of the strongest learners. The SoW says to cold-call the 2–3 learners with the biggest shift first and to plan targeted questions for those with partial understanding. The notes do not say whether H is one of the strongest or an extra.
findings.fix: State one order: the 2–3 strongest learners take Students A to C. Give Student H to another confident learner. Give simpler questions (D to G) to learners with partial understanding.

findings.problem: The resource notes mark predict.reading (CK-12 Wound Healing Process) as 'preview_first … use only after the class story is built', but no slide or note places it. The build_log says no listed resource fits the lesson. These two statements contradict each other. The aliases (observe.reading and others) are not covered in resource_notes. The build_log also says the Observe phase uses 17 minutes, but the slides and glance give 21.
findings.fix: Either place predict.reading as an optional extension after the class story, or mark it do_not_use and fix the build_log wording. Correct the Observe time in the build_log to 21 minutes.

findings.problem: The Summary Table takes 2 minutes of the 80 and is run 'at the end or as homework'. If it is set as homework, those 2 minutes are not accounted for. The SoW final message ('Take that with you into the next sub-strand') is the natural close, and the summary comes after it.
findings.fix: Say clearly that the summary is either done in class in 2 minutes or set as homework, and then give the 2 minutes to the assessment or the DQB phase.

findings.problem: For the SoW owner: the SoW has several errors that the deck correctly avoids or does not copy. The phenomenon says 'Form 1'. The sub-strand number is inconsistent (1.1, 1.3, and '1.3 Chemicals of Life'). The SoW cites 'onion cell microscopy in Lesson 3', but that practical is Lesson 6. NGSS is named. Lesson 11 gives a group poster, yet Lesson 12 expects each learner to have a revised model. The SoW also names no protein for the platelet question. These are logged in the build_log.
findings.fix: No deck change is needed. The SoW owner should correct these items. The build_log already flags them.

build_log.slide: Re-read what you wrote in Lesson 1
build_log.sow_says: A Form 1 student in Nairobi cuts their finger slicing onions for supper.
build_log.deck_does: The slide says 'A student in Nairobi cuts their finger...' and leaves out the grade. The SoW wording 'Form 1' is not shown to students.
build_log.why: The manual says never 'Form 1' (CBE: Grade 10). The SoW still uses 'Form 1' in the phenomenon (also in the unit text). The SoW owner should update it to match.

build_log.sow_says: Unit substrand: 'Sub-Strand 1.3: Cell Structure and Specialisation'; lesson substrand: 'Sub-Strand 1.1: Cell Structure'; teacher reflection: 'Sub-Strand 1.3 (Chemicals of Life)'
build_log.deck_does: Slides avoid sub-strand numbers. Only 'the next sub-strand' is used in the notes.
build_log.why: The sub-strand number and name differ between the unit label, the lesson label and the teacher reflection. The SoW owner should make them consistent.

build_log.slide: Then vs. Now: write three sentences
build_log.sow_says: 'the onion cell microscopy in Lesson 3' (Explain phase, formative assessment)
build_log.deck_does: The deck does not name a lesson number for the onion practical. The notes only say learners should name a specific lesson activity.
build_log.why: The onion microscopy practical is Lesson 6 in the SoW storyline, not Lesson 3. The SoW owner should correct it.

build_log.slide: Stages 1 to 3: the cut and the clot
build_log.sow_says: 'Platelets. What is unusual about platelet structure...' and 'What protein do platelets help deploy? What organelle in other cells produces proteins like that?'
build_log.deck_does: The slide keeps the SoW questions as written. The answer key says platelets are small pieces with no nucleus.
build_log.why: Platelets are cell fragments, not whole cells, so calling them a 'cell' may confuse learners. The SoW also names no specific protein.

build_log.slide: Stages 1 to 3: the cut and the clot
build_log.sow_says: 'What is the FIRST cell to respond when the cut happens?' and 'What protein do platelets help deploy?' (no answers given)
build_log.deck_does: The answer key gives platelets as the first cell, and fibrin as the clotting protein made on ribosomes (many on rough ER).
build_log.why: The SoW gives no answers for these cold-call questions. These are standard textbook facts that the teacher checker should verify.

build_log.slide: Stages 1 to 3: the cut and the clot
build_log.sow_says: 'Student C: What protein do platelets help deploy? What organelle in other cells produces proteins like that?'
build_log.deck_does: The answer key says proteins are made on ribosomes, many of which sit on the rough endoplasmic reticulum.
build_log.why: The SoW does not state the organelle answer. This is an established fact; please verify.

build_log.sow_says: 'You have [insert time as per school policy] minutes.' and 'The assessment tasks learners to: (a) label and describe a diagram of a specialised cell; (b)... (c)... (d)...'
build_log.deck_does: The deck gives the assessment 15 minutes so that all times add up to 80. The deck does not include the assessment paper or marking scheme.
build_log.why: The SoW gives no assessment duration, no paper and no marking scheme. The teacher checker should confirm the timing against school policy.

build_log.sow_says: 'Learners complete an individual written exit reflection... before sitting the sub-strand summative assessment.'
build_log.deck_does: The Summary Table slide is done at the end or as homework with 2 minutes, as required by the build rules.
build_log.why: The SoW's total phase times (about 4+3, the 8 cold-call rounds, 8, 5 and the assessment) are not all stated, so the deck times were set to fit exactly 80 minutes. No activity was cut.

build_log.sow_says: 'The teacher displays the full Driving Question Board — all question cards posted since Lesson 1.'
build_log.deck_does: The deck refers to 'each question card' on the class board. It does not list the actual cards.
build_log.why: The cards are written by the class during the unit, so the deck cannot list them. The teacher uses the real board.

build_log.slide: Then vs. Now: write three sentences
build_log.sow_says: No ARES resource is named in this lesson.
build_log.deck_does: No ARES resource icon is placed on any slide.
build_log.why: None of the listed resources fits this consolidation lesson well, and several are Khan Academy or CK-12 material on plant and animal cell comparison, which is not needed here.

build_log.sow_says: Teacher Moves for Observe phase: 'COLD-CALL SEQUENCE (minimum 8 students)' with 'WAIT 12 seconds' per question
build_log.deck_does: The Observe phase uses 17 minutes across 5 slides to fit the 8 cold-call rounds plus set-up and silent reading.
build_log.why: This keeps every cold-call question, in the SoW order, while keeping the lesson at exactly 80 minutes. The overflowing slides were shortened for layout; no activity was cut.

build_log.sow_says: The SoW lists no quantities for materials (for example sticky notes, stickers, assessment papers).
build_log.deck_does: The glance lists the materials with no quantities, only 'each learner' or 'one per learner' where the SoW implies it.
build_log.why: Nothing may be invented. The SoW owner should add quantities if needed.

build_log.sow_says: Lesson titles such as 'Microscopy Practical 1 — Observing Onion Epidermal Cells' and 'Consolidation, DQB Closure, and Final Explanation — The Healing Cut Fully Explained'
build_log.deck_does: The unit map uses shortened titles of at most 6 words, using only words from each SoW title.
build_log.why: The unit map layout needs short titles. No new names were invented.

build_log.slide: Then vs. Now: write three sentences
build_log.sow_says: Lesson 12 Explain phase: 'Learners place their Lesson 1 cell diagram and their most recent (Lesson 11) revised model side by side'; Lesson 11 overview: 'In groups of four, learners construct a final annotated poster-model'
build_log.deck_does: The deck follows Lesson 12 and tells learners to use their Lesson 11 revised model, or the group poster if that is all they have.
build_log.why: Lesson 11 produces a group poster, so it is not clear that each learner has an individual revised model. The SoW owner should say what each learner keeps.

build_log.slide: Then vs. Now: write three sentences
build_log.sow_says: 'This is the NGSS Science and Engineering Practice of Obtaining, Evaluating, and Communicating Information.'
build_log.deck_does: The deck does not mention NGSS on any slide or in the notes.
build_log.why: The SoW refers to a US framework in a Kenyan CBE lesson. The SoW owner should replace it with a CBE reference or remove it.

build_log.sow_says: The lesson plan names no next lesson. The teacher reflection mentions 'Sub-Strand 1.3 (Chemicals of Life) and Strand 3.2 (Transport in Animals)'.
build_log.deck_does: The teaser says only 'New questions from our Future Questions Wall.' It names no sub-strand topic.
